definitions.gloss: at least, at the very least
definitions.explanation: Indicating the minimum amount, number, or extent.

examples.japanese: {少|すく}なくとも⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It will take at least 30 minutes.

examples.japanese: {少|すく}なくとも⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: At least one week is necessary.

examples.japanese: {少|すく}なくとも⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: At least, that's what I think.

notes:
{少|すく}なくとも expresses a minimum threshold.

FORMS:
⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ (few, little) + く (adverb form) + とも (at least)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {少|すく}なくとも: at least (neutral, formal)
- ⟦せめて→せめて：10344_semete⟧: at least (implies desire for more)
- ⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧でも: at minimum

USAGE:
{少|すく}なくとも is often used for quantities, time, or to express a minimum opinion. It's more objective than ⟦せめて→せめて：10344_semete⟧, which has an emotional nuance of wishing for more.
